title: Why Indian men don't want to marry?
description:
More and more Indian men are choosing to stay single or delay marriage—but why? Is it fear, logic, or just changing priorities?

From rising divorce rates and alimony fears to the pressure of one-sided expectations, many men feel that marriage today is more of a legal trap than a partnership. Add to that financial burdens, in-law drama, and the fear of false cases, and it’s no surprise that commitment feels like a risk.

In this video, we explore why Indian men are backing away from marriage—and what that says about our evolving society.
